title: What's new modal
brief: Improve the modal that tells the user what an update brings: the release notes now show raw markdown (## and ** visible, bullets glued into one paragraph). Show the real notes, readable, in the app's own dark theme.

artboards.title: A: Release notes as a document
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to today's dialog and the calmest: a version pill, a clear list and a divider before the footer; less personality, scales to any length by scrolling

artboards.title: B: Version hero
artboards.tradeoff: Makes the update an event with a large version and one card per change; friendlier and scannable, but taller and heavier for a modal shown once per version

artboards.title: C: Compact and quiet
artboards.tradeoff: Smallest and least intrusive: two changes visible, the rest behind a disclosure; hides detail unless the user opens it and needs a link to the full notes
